body:
ai_turn_towards now uses humanness_smooth_turn_step, target_yaw gets real Gaussian aim noise from aim_error_deg (previously dead data, now consumed), next_attack_ms jittered via humanness_reaction_delay_ms. Found real gap: story_ai_tick has no live call site in main.c (pre-existing, not fixed here). Live-verified via direct integration test (3000 real ticks, 117 jittered attack cycles). Commit SHANKPIT d28d840.

⚓ ☃
title: Humanness Phase 2: wired into story_ai.c
